 About the match
 On this page you can find the Pakhtakor vs Al Nassr FC match lineup for AFC Champions League Elite — Round 4, on Monday 02-11-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Pakhtakor lines up in a 4-2-3-1 led by Sobirkhuzhaev, while Al Nassr FC sets up in a 4-4-1-1 led by Al-Amri. Pakhtakor is led by head coach Emilian Caras, while Al Nassr FC is managed by Ange Postecoglou. The match is played at Pakhtakor Markaziy Stadium.
